title: A reset arc clears a place
text: The transition `restart` drains every token from `pending` and puts back the one token it deposits there, so `pending` ends holding exactly that token. A reset arc never blocks its transition: `restart` also fires when `pending` is already empty.

steps.text: The transition `work` takes one of the three `pending` tokens.
The transition `restart` drains both remaining tokens and deposits one: `pending` holds 1.
The transition `work` takes that token. The place `pending` is empty.
The place `pending` is empty, and `restart` fires anyway: the reset arc is not a precondition.
No restart request is left in `restartReq`, so the input arc blocks `restart`.
